note: On the southeast shore of Payne Lake, 25 km west of Cardston on Hwy 5 (18 km east of Waterton Lakes National Park). Some sites are right on the water with views to the mountains, others in mixed forest a short walk back. Boat launch and pier; no towing on the lake. Firewood is sold in summer. --Claude
